capabilities: Read a note aloud with streaming playback
Read selected text aloud from the context menu
Save a note as an MP3 embed in the vault
Choose from 500+ voices in 80+ languages with adjustable speed
Skip properties, code blocks, math, comments, HTML, URLs and embeds when reading
extras: Freemium: a free plan with a monthly character allowance exists; paid plans add credits. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4+. The API key is stored in Obsidian's keychain and may be unencrypted on systems without a secret store.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to listen to notes as spoken audio or export a note as an MP3.

relations.evidence: The plugin turns text into speech on Lazybird's servers.

summary: Text-to-speech plugin that reads notes aloud with AI voices and saves them as MP3 files via the Lazybird service.
